text: I notice the patient's responses seem to be repeating a standard denial script, but your description of the rash as raised, erythematous, and symmetric on extensor surfaces is highly suggestive of Gottron's papules. I need to confirm if there is any associated muscle weakness or specific photosensitivity to distinguish this from other dermatoses. Do you experience any proximal muscle weakness, such as difficulty lifting your arms above your head or rising from a seated position?
